assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
The symptoms are episodic in nature.
There is a need to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances.
CPT 93226 represents a 48-hour Holter monitoring study.
CPT 93226 is medically necessary to capture potential arrhythmic episodes.
The study will assist in confirming the diagnosis and guiding appropriate rate or rhythm control management.
The study directly supports the indications documented for this service.
The diagnosis codes are I48.0, I47.1, and I49.9.
The denial reason code is PR-204.
